name: brown_dwarfs
notes: Depths are 1 - (flux in the band / power-law continuum), averaged over the 1.6, 2.2, 3.3 um methane and 1.4, 1.9, 2.7 um water features that were measured; 0 = no absorption.
Errors are Monte Carlo errors of the band fluxes, multiplied by 1.49: the scatter of isolated reference stars beyond their formal errors (methane_err_formal keeps the unscaled value).

suggests_brown_dwarf needs methane AND water each >= 0.15 deep and >= 3 sigma; star_like needs a methane depth below 0.3 at 2 sigma. A suggestion from a low-resolution spectrum, never a classification.

contaminated: a Gaia DR3 / 2MASS neighbour could supply >= 50% of the measured flux in a band the indices use (PSF overlap with 1.5 px aperture, stellar SED extrapolated with a Rayleigh-Jeans tail). neighbour_subtracted repeats the indices after removing that predicted flux: a cross-check only.
color_1_4um = m_AB(1.22-1.31 um) - m_AB(3.95-4.15 um); a Rayleigh-Jeans star is -2.5.
Exposures of all passes are combined: a variable object's spectrum mixes its states.
Dev-cache fields (barnard, r-dra) have no EPSF in their files: aperture corrections there come from the header PSF_FWHM (aperture_correction says which).
